author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Constitution for legitimate help and later adversarial conclusions

scenes.title: When help cannot hear no
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel the sting of help being refused Meet a dialogue built around that moment
scenes.composition: A useful ramp leads home while its resident asks the helper to pause
addOrChange: Keep the help real and the refusal gentle.

cues.narration: You wanted to help; the person you helped wants you to stop.
cues.visualAction: The helper stops when the resident raises a hand.

cues.narration: The Right to Help places that painful moment at the center of a philosophical dialogue.
cues.visualAction: Hold both people at equal scale as the dialogue is introduced.

scenes.title: Two voices under pressure
scenes.viewerPurpose: Want to hear a human and AI challenge each other Notice that doing good can collect power
scenes.composition: A human and a modest AI dialogue consider the same helping action
addOrChange: Replace gate apparatus with the organization supplying practical care.

cues.narration: A human author and an AI voice question the desire to reduce suffering.
cues.visualAction: Put the two speaking perspectives beside the human encounter.

cues.narration: They follow care into charities, emergencies, and organizations that grow powerful by doing good.
cues.visualAction: Widen to the care organization and its growing responsibilities.

scenes.title: The person being helped
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel why both waiting and intervening can hurt See that good intentions cannot settle the argument
scenes.composition: Two plans expose costs of waiting and acting without agreement
addOrChange: Replace abstract return arrow with the recipient’s own plan.

cues.narration: Sometimes waiting abandons someone; sometimes intervention takes over a life.
cues.visualAction: Show the waiting need beside the cost of overriding a refusal.

cues.narration: Neither speaker can settle the conflict by declaring their intentions pure.
cues.visualAction: Keep both plans open while the participants reconsider.

scenes.title: Care without possession
scenes.viewerPurpose: Recall a time when your own help met resistance Ask what care owes someone who says no
scenes.composition: The resident retains a key beside the useful ramp
addOrChange: Remove solved-repair reveal and keep the helper outside listening.

cues.narration: If you have ever tried to help and met resistance, their disagreement may feel familiar.
cues.visualAction: The helper listens instead of directing the resident.

cues.narration: What does care owe the person who refuses our version of a better future?
cues.visualAction: End with the resident’s key and room for a different answer.
